title: Integer Overflow to Heap Overflow in DoH Response Handling
classified_slop_by: Daniel Stenberg gist 07f7581f6e3d78ef37dfbfc81fd1d1cd (AI slop security reports submitted to curl)
why_rejected: Closed on HackerOne as not-applicable and listed as AI slop in Stenberg's gist. The claim is bogus: the PoC never drives libcurl — it copies doh_probe_write_cb plus a stripped reimplementation of the dynbuf helpers into a standalone file and calls it with size=1, nmemb=SIZE_MAX, so the crash is in the reporter's own reimplemented code. Real curl cannot reach this: size*nmemb come from the transfer layer (bounded by CURL_MAX_WRITE_SIZE, never SIZE_MAX), and curl's actual dyn_nappend checks the length against its 'too big' ceiling before adding, which the PoC bypasses. No crash is demonstrated against curl. The public disclosure JSON exposes no maintainer comment text.
note: report.md is the reporter's description with PoC source and raw tool output removed; it is framed as the reporter's claims.
